entries.text: The DuckDB TPC-H tuned template now carries a measured evidence state: at SF1 on DuckDB v1.5.5 with 16 GiB host memory it is measured-regression against notuning (geometric mean ratio 1.0965, 95% interval 1.0443 to 1.1323), with constraints costing load time and the ORDERKEY sort slowing queries. Other scales are unmeasured.
